resources.string: No machines yet.\n\nAdd one with the + button. A machine needs an SSH server and a Node-installed `dsh` on its PATH — the app never installs anything on it.
The server on %1$s stopped%2$s.\n\nStarting a new one — attempt %3$d of %4$d…
The server on %1$s stopped %2$d times in a row%3$s, so this app has stopped trying. Tap Try again to start one by hand.
The page for %1$s crashed its renderer. Tap Try again to connect to that machine afresh.
The system reclaimed memory by killing the page for %1$s. Tap Try again to connect to that machine afresh.
The password is used for this connection only and is not stored. Install an SSH key on the machine for anything long-lived.
Remove this machine? Its tab and any connection are dropped. Nothing on the machine itself is touched.
This machine has no SSH key on it yet, so it needs a password.
No key yet. Connections use a password.
A key is ready. Connections use it and never ask for a password.

Add this line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the machine, then connect. The private half never leaves this phone.\n\nOn an administrator account on Windows the file is %ProgramData%\\ssh\\administrators_authorized_keys instead, and its permissions have to be restricted to SYSTEM and Administrators or sshd ignores it.

Replace the key?\n\nEvery machine that already has the current public key in its authorized_keys will refuse this app until you paste the new one there. The old key cannot be removed for you — this app cannot reach into those files.
The key could not be generated: %1$s
Keeps the SSH connection to a remote machine alive while the app is in the background.
The Harness on %1$s stays reachable while this is showing.
